description: This is a C source file implementing display driver functions for the ili9341 display controller using SPI protocol. It includes initialization routines, power management, and data blitting functions tailored for this specific hardware.

methods.name: int lws_display_ili9341_spi_init(const struct lws_display * disp)
methods.description: Initializes the ili9341 display through SPI, including hardware reset and sending configuration commands.

methods.name: int lws_display_ili9341_spi_brightness(const struct lws_display * disp,uint8_t b)
methods.description: Stub for setting display brightness via PWM (currently does nothing).

methods.name: int lws_display_ili9341_spi_blit(const struct lws_display * disp,const uint8_t * src,lws_display_scalar x,lws_display_scalar y,lws_display_scalar w,lws_display_scalar h)
methods.description: Copies a block of pixel data to the display, implemented as a line-by-line blit.

methods.name: int lws_display_ili9341_spi_power(const struct lws_display * disp,int state)
methods.description: Controls the power state (sleep or wake) of the display.
